title: Require explicit alpha gate outcomes
summary: Alpha release bundle validation should require every evidence command to carry an explicit outcome so accepted bundles cannot hide unrun gates by deleting the pending marker.
expectedFailureModes: Accepted release notes omit a gate result for a required evidence command.
Skipped gates are accepted without a reason.
Malformed gate result text bypasses acceptance validation.
humanEscalation: A release operator must still decide whether failed or skipped gates allow a rejected, superseded, or human-approved candidate decision.
nextAction: Parse validation.md required-gate lines, require result passed/failed/skipped for every evidence command, require skipped reasons, and document the result contract.
